material.acceptance_criteria: After a reload fails, the sim unit count, the named regions and the pending timers equal their values before the reload, and the reload harness prints a reload-check line that proves it.
material.description: ModHost::reload in rust/crates/mod-host/src/lib.rs runs compile(), which executes the new chunk's top-level code against the live world, regions and timers before validation can fail. spawn_unit, define_region (which overwrites a named region) and schedule therefore persist after the error, and only hooks and version roll back. reload_harness (rust/crates/mod-host/src/bin/reload_harness.rs) checks value and version only.
material.resolution: A rejected reload restores the sim state, regions, timers and queued commands (save_live and restore_live, mod-host lib.rs). The reload harness checks a runtime error after a spawn, a region and a timer; prints reload-check rejected reload left world unchanged ok. Note: commit 3b442dd has a mislabeled message; its wasip2 job was red and cb054d3 is the green witness.
material.subject: A rejected mod reload leaves top-level side effects in the live sim
material.witness_plan: Extend reload_harness with a broken v2 whose top-level code calls spawn_unit, define_region and schedule before a syntax error; assert unit count, in_region results and timer firing match v1; CI greps the new reload-check rollback-state line.
